description: This file contains the implementation of an Ethernet driver for NXP S32 GMAC hardware within Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, interrupt handling, and data transmission/reception functions.

methods.name: get_iface
methods.description: Returns the appropriate network interface, considering VLAN tagging.

methods.name: convert_phy_to_mac_config
methods.description: Converts PHY link speed and duplex info into GMAC configuration.

methods.name: phy_link_state_changed
methods.description: Callback invoked on PHY link state change to update MAC configuration and link status.

methods.name: select_phy_interface
methods.description: Selects the PHY interface mode based on the hardware configuration.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_init
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet device, including clocks, PHY, and GMAC controller.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_start
methods.description: Starts the Ethernet interface, enabling controller and interrupts.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_stop
methods.description: Stops the Ethernet interface, disabling controller and interrupts.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_tx
methods.description: Transmits a network packet via GMAC.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_get_pkt
methods.description: Retrieves a received packet from GMAC buffers and constructs a net_pkt.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_rx
methods.description: Handles reception of a frame from GMAC and passes it to network stack.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_rx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for processing received frames, handling polling and interrupts.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_set_config
methods.description: Configures Ethernet device parameters such as MAC address and promiscuous mode.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns the hardware capabilities of the Ethernet device.

methods.name: eth_nxp_s32_rx_irq
methods.description: Interrupt handler for receive frame available.
